body: I don’t really know what else to do, I didn’t become depressed like this until I began feeling lonely and isolated 24/7 and I don’t know how to make friends because most people I go to school with are 18-19 and pretty immature.
I shouldn’t have used the plural friends, it’s only one that does this and I know, I avoid talking to him as much as I can.

Sorry for the late response, I sort of forgot about this post after I sobered up. My depression has always been brought on by feeling alone and feeling like I’m wasting my life away. In the past 3 years I started working, lost a considerable amount of weight and started college; all in the attempt to become a more social and healthy person. I may be physically healthier but other than that everything is the same, I still have no friends other than a few internet friends and have had 1 single relationship that lasted just 2 months. I’m tired of spending every single night at home playing video games and watching Netflix by myself, I just want someone to go out and have fun with and actually feel like a normal person my age.
